report.title: Memo detail page not refresh after editing and saving the content
report.body:
### Pre-submission Checklist

- [x] I have searched the existing issues and this bug has not been reported yet
- [x] I have tested this issue on the [demo site](https://demo.usememos.com) or the latest version

### Where did you encounter this bug?

Demo site (demo.usememos.com)

### Memos Version

v0.26.2

### Bug Description

On the memo details page, after editing and saving the content, the page still displays the old content before editing.

### Steps to Reproduce

1. Copy memo link using "Copy Link" menu
2. Visit memo detail page with the link
3. Edit memo content
4. Click save button

### Expected Behavior

The memo detail page should show the new content after edit, but it shows the old content, you have to refresh browser to get latest content.

### Screenshots & Additional Context

_No response_

preconditions: the app has no memos initially, so one must be created
the memo has an editable body and a 'Copy Link' option in its menu
steps: Create a new memo with some text content (for example 'original content') and save it
Open the menu of the newly created memo
Click the memo's timestamp or title link to open the memo detail page
Open the memo's menu on the detail page and click 'Edit'
Change the memo content to 'edited content'
plan.expected: After saving, the memo detail page shows the new text 'edited content' and no longer shows 'original content', without a browser refresh.
plan.reported_actual: After saving, the memo detail page still shows the old content; a browser refresh is needed to see the updated content.
missing: assumed: no memos exist, so a memo with the content 'original content' is created first, since the report gives no content
assumed: visiting the copied link is equivalent to opening the memo detail page by clicking the memo's timestamp, since the clipboard cannot be pasted reliably
assumed: the edit is done through the memo's menu 'Edit' option on the detail page
What was the original content and what was the edited content?
Does the issue occur only when arriving via a copied link (direct page load) rather than navigating from the list?
plan.summary: Memo detail page keeps showing old content after editing and saving until browser refresh
